name: io.github.inamprotocol/inam-mcp
description: Check an agent's INAM reputation before trusting it, and sign a receipt when work is done.

environmentVariables.name: INAM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Registry base URL. Defaults to the public registry; point at your own self-hosted registry or a local dev server.

environmentVariables.name: INAM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 private key. Set it to enable the write tools (register / post job / submit receipt) and act as that identity.
